label: sec:yekutieli-lifting-kummer-motivic-preamble
html:
We incorporate the motivic enrichment of the Quantum lifting condition. The Kummer-filtration obstruction identifies the fermionic-twisted lifts. The Kummer tower organises this filtration. The Hochschild–Kummer connection interfaces with cyclic-homology data. We define the motivic substrate and its Galois character. We establish the motivic-perpetual-obstruction (proved via Route A: prime-ideal collapse, C = a_0(-1) + 2 \cdot a_1(-1)).

This motivic-enriched Yekutieli machinery serves as the native Galois substrate for the q-geometric-Langlands chapter. The spectral side of the Langlands functor pairs against the Galois character. The motivic perpetual obstruction theorem supplies the structural obstacle that the spectral pairing navigates. Readers focused on the substrate level may treat the obstruction class as a black box. We defer its archimedean specialisation to the Descartes-universe chapter.
